editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher blurbs, jacket copy, excerpts, review text, reader-review text and rating aggregates are never copied or mirrored; Swoon'd writes its own explanation and links to the original. No cover art is displayed; illustrations are original Swoon'd art. Talk about works, link out (spec section 40).

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: I can follow and join a conversation about books: I understand what readers mean by tropes, DNF, TBR and POV, place a book on the genre map, know how prizes and publishing work at a conversational level, recommend without spoiling or faking expertise, and ask honest, interested follow-up questions about what someone loves to read.

licensingConstraints.constraint: No book covers, jacket art, author photos or publisher imagery. All images are original Swoon'd illustrations of formats, anatomy and genre conventions (license id original-swoond). Open Library Covers and Google Books thumbnails are not used.

Publisher blurbs, jacket copy, excerpts, critic reviews and reader-review text are never copied, stored or shown. Swoon'd writes its own descriptions; link-out only. Passages used in exercises are original Swoon'd text, not quotations of real books.
No audiobook clips or narration. The course has no audio assets and does not use listening-id.

Open Library APIs are not for bulk or high-traffic commercial use (identify with a User-Agent; use monthly dumps; catalogue data is CC0/open). Google Books API terms bar charging users without a separate Google agreement and bar permanent copies; not used in production. ISBNdb is paid and allows caching only while a subscription is current. Goodreads retired its public API (no new keys since 2020); The StoryGraph has no public API. Hardcover's GraphQL API terms to be confirmed. NYT Books API needs a commercial-terms check. No scraping.
Prize names, imprints, Goodreads, StoryGraph, Amazon, Audible and BookTok are used as text only, descriptively; no logos. Store copy wording pending legal read.
Author and translator names appear as facts only: no likeness, endorsements or fabricated quotes; public professional record only.

Star ratings and reader reviews from Goodreads and similar services belong to their providers: no mirrored tables or scraping. Sexual-content and censorship topics are taught as labelling and factual literacy at survey depth; no explicit text.

safetyConstraints: No physical-safety risk; this is a media-culture course.
Sexual content (romance heat levels) and violence (thrillers) are described at survey depth with no explicit text, taught as labelling literacy, and never pushed at a reader of unknown age.
Memoir, grief and mental-health writing is never gamified or scored; self-help lessons teach critical reading and never give medical or mental-health advice.
Banned and challenged books are covered factually and neutrally without taking a side in a live political dispute.
Never suggest or link to pirated copies; link only to libraries, publishers and legitimate retailers.
